title: Settings
subtitle: Manage app preferences, downloaded models, and offline knowledge packs.
language_section_desc: Switch the interface language. Arabic switches the layout to right-to-left.
chat_desc: Preferences for refusals and closest-match suggestions.
display_desc: Sunlight Mode hard-contrast palette for direct sun and glare.
models_desc: Download, import, and load on-device chat models.
packs_desc: Import and toggle offline knowledge packs.
smoke_test_desc: Throwaway: render Sketch 002 ladder for visual review.
auto_send_voice_body: Send the final in-app microphone transcript straight into chat when on-device speech recognition finishes.
audio_scribe_model_body: Choose which on-device model handles Audio Scribe. You can still switch to system speech per clip.
audio_scribe_set_default_a11y: Set {{displayName}} as the Audio Scribe default
note_theme_body: OfflineAid follows your device color scheme across the current app screens.
note_storage_body: Downloaded models and imported packs stay on this device until you remove them from their dedicated settings pages.
note_keyboard_mic_body: Your device keyboard may also offer a mic button, but OfflineAid does not treat that as the guaranteed-offline path. The app's own mic button is the trusted offline-first voice input route.
suggest_closest_match: Suggest closest pack content on refusals
suggest_closest_match_body: When no pack covers your question, also show the closest grounded snippet from your packs. May be off-topic, verify before acting.
sunlight_mode_note: System Dark Mode and Sunlight Mode are independent. Sunlight Mode does not auto-change the theme. When you turn it on while Dark is active, the app will offer a one-tap switch to Light because Light has less OLED bloom under sun.
sunlight_mode_body: Hard-contrast palette (pure white / pure black, 2px borders, body text at least 7:1). For direct sun, glare, snow-reflection. Independent of system Dark Mode.
os_high_contrast_detected: Detected: system high-contrast preference is on. Sunlight Mode stays on regardless of this toggle until you disable system contrast in OS Settings.
language_picker_reload_body: Arabic uses a right-to-left layout. Restart the app to apply the new layout direction.
